title: AI-led hospitality storytelling
prompt: Find AI-led content for a global hospitality brand. I am looking for a cinematic brand film that brings hotel environments, fictional characters and membership benefits to life within a constrained event budget. The work must use generative AI in the actual production, rather than simply advertise a product with AI features, and must be relevant to hotels or hospitality. A humorous narrative and a luxury travel setting would be useful. Keep distinct slide versions of the same project as separate results, and explain which parts of the original slide support the match.

evidence.quote: Every scene was generated using AI

checks: Distinguish AI used to make a film from AI being the product being advertised; retain both hotel-film versions.

title: Interactive experiences with measured outcomes
prompt: Find interactive digital or immersive experiences with measurable outcomes. The audience must actively participate, rather than only watch a conventional film, and the original material must report a quantified audience or campaign result such as views, reach, engagement rate or conversion. I am interested in responsive installations, interactive storytelling or digital experiences that make a complex subject tangible. Sustainability would be a useful theme. Do not treat the number of projectors, screens, soundscapes, planned activities or people affected by a social problem as proof of campaign effectiveness. If an experience is relevant but no measured result is supplied, explain that gap instead of inventing an outcome.

evidence.quote: Motion and touch-sensitive foliage triggered shifting light, colour and sound

checks: A deliberate evidence-gap query: interactive installation is documented, quantified campaign effectiveness is not.

title: Conservation storytelling with proven reach
prompt: I need a purpose-led environmental campaign that turns a complex conservation issue into a bold, accessible film for public audiences and decision-makers. The case must contain a quantified campaign outcome, rather than only describe an ambition or say engagement was strong. I would prefer a cinematic concept, recognisable talent, social distribution and evidence that the campaign contributed to wider conversation or policy action. Please prioritise the original evidence for reach or views and distinguish real results from background statistics about the environmental problem. General sustainability films can be related examples, but should not be called a high match when measured outcomes are missing.
checks: Outcome evidence comes from the original Impact section; general sustainability relevance is insufficient.

title: Global internal strategy communications
prompt: Find a case showing how a large organisation turned a complex internal strategy launch into an ongoing content ecosystem for employees and senior partners across countries. It must include both a leadership webcast and a podcast series, with a consistent creative or audio identity across the formats. I would prefer an example at the scale of hundreds of thousands of employees or thousands of partners, supported by leadership participation and promotional assets. A standalone podcast is a useful partial match but does not satisfy the full multi-format requirement. Include separate versions and continuation slides where their evidence is relevant, even when a record still has missing structured metadata.

evidence.quote: A 30-minute live studio All In Webcast

checks: Both formats are mandatory; Needs Review remains searchable; duplicate titles retain independent slide identity.

title: Reusable multilingual leadership content
prompt: Show me scalable multilingual leadership content for international corporate events. The work must use AI voice dubbing or lip-sync to let a senior leader address audiences in their own languages, and must allow reuse without additional filming for each language or event. Human editing or oversight is a preference because brand trust matters. Generic AI interviews, avatars with no multilingual evidence, or a conventional film about AI are only related examples. I want the original evidence for the multilingual production method and the reduction in repeated shoots, not an invented estimate of cost savings or audience performance.

evidence.quote: AI voice dubbing and sophisticated lip-sync technology
With no need for additional filming

checks: Require the actual multilingual production method and reusable filming evidence; preserve both link variants.
